articles.summary: Originally posted to LinkedIn.At a clinic in Chicago, it’s usually an Ob-Gyn who treats cervical precancer (when abnormal cells appear on the surface of the opening of the uterus). In Kenya, where there are approximately 500 Ob-Gyns in the entire country, a nurse or midwife treats it, if it gets treated at all. articles.title: Why CRCL Can Be Used by an Ob-Gyn in Chicago and a Midwife in Nairobi
